primary_metric: Original task geometric SuccessOnce, stop on first success; 0.06m xy distance and 0<z difference<0.03m.
policy_settings: Keep each checkpoint own published method settings, ds4/one inference step for FLASH and ds1/ten steps for FM-DiT. No new training or test-based checkpoint selection.
paired_initials: Both methods must load the same frozen file and log test_id and input-state SHA256 plus actual reset observation/native-state fingerprints.
reset_rule: Fresh native mj_resetData before every env.reset, identical for both methods; no passive 200-step warmup in scored episodes. CPU passive checks are only a separate validity screen.
normalizer_rule: Use saved checkpoint normalizers only; test states never enter training Zarr, training/validation or normalizer fitting.
optional_supplemental_metric: If requested, separately repeat frozen bowl-stable-v1-20261028 without replacing the primary metric. No release/withdrawal intervention in scored runs.
runtime_control: Use the same allocated physical GPU for both methods; record UUID and versions. GPU selection is deferred; no reserved or scheduled job.
reporting: Separate from original 40-demo replay experiment. Describe as fixed-robot initial-state object-position generalization within the training empirical bounding box, not the paper original randomized test sampler. Report every rollout and paired outcomes.
current_execution_status: CPU preparation only. Do not execute policy inference or use any GPU until user authorizes GPU work.
